capabilities.claim_boundary: A gated training workflow is not an unrestricted self-improving agent.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Resumable training and promotion gates exist; unrestricted autonomous learning does not.
capabilities.required_proof: Pre-registered objective, fixed evaluator, rollback, independent holdout, resource ledger, and human authorization receipts.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Exact token inversion does not demonstrate semantic English understanding.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports 25,600/25,600 exact representation and inverse cycles.
capabilities.required_proof: Import the evaluator output, token universe definition, executable command, and source hash.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Using chemistry-inspired constraints is not chemistry question-answering capability.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Chemistry currently contributes conservation receipts, not learned chemistry knowledge.
capabilities.required_proof: Curated held-out chemistry benchmark, contamination audit, baselines, calibration, and multi-seed results.

capabilities.claim_boundary: This is a scoped internal code/opcode evaluator, not HumanEval or general software engineering.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Promoted cap-then-grow receipt reports 0.506 mean coding accuracy across three seeds, SD 0.034699; representative seed peak 0.536.
capabilities.required_proof: Re-run from the hashed parent, preserve task IDs, and add a standardized held-out coding benchmark.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Connectivity and durable coordination are infrastructure capabilities, not native model intelligence.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports SSH, Tailscale, a verified bridge, and shared-ledger coordination.
capabilities.required_proof: Fresh two-host round trip, ledger replica receipt, failure recovery, and clock-skew handling.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Successful orchestration is a system result and must attribute every external model and tool.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Terminal orchestration can route work to Ollama or external agents.
capabilities.required_proof: Task-level route traces, model/tool attribution, success criteria, cost, latency, and human interventions.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Architecture presence is not a trained arithmetic capability.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Architecture exists, but no qualified unified checkpoint was identified.
capabilities.required_proof: Checkpoint, operation-balanced held-out set, length extrapolation, multi-seed accuracy, and baselines.

capabilities.claim_boundary: External-model coding output must not be attributed to Clay's native weights.
capabilities.evidence_summary: General coding is currently routed to qwen2.5-coder:3b or another external model.
capabilities.required_proof: Per-task model attribution, tool trace, execution result, and cost/latency receipt.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Dataset size, alphabet, split, and seed are not yet available on this host.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports 92.3% accuracy on clean letters.
capabilities.required_proof: Import glyph dataset manifest, split, evaluator, confusion matrix, seed, and checkpoint hash.

capabilities.claim_boundary: A perfect score is held until denominator, split, and duplicate controls are imported.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports 100% accuracy on clean trits.
capabilities.required_proof: Import evaluator receipt, denominator, duplicate scan, split, seed, and checkpoint hash.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Noise sampling, task balance, repeats, and confidence interval are not yet imported.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports about 69% with two flipped pixels.
capabilities.required_proof: Import deterministic corruption seeds, all noise strata, task counts, baseline, and dispersion.

capabilities.claim_boundary: One 18-example held-out challenge is preliminary and does not establish general honesty.
capabilities.evidence_summary: A promoted character-GRU judge reports held-out MAE improvement from 0.722222 to 0.666667 on 18 examples.
capabilities.required_proof: Larger grouped challenge split, three seeds, calibrated intervals, and an untouched external test.

capabilities.claim_boundary: A temporary peak is adaptive selection evidence and must not replace a multi-seed estimate.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports 16.7% for a broad checkpoint and a temporary 20% peak.
capabilities.required_proof: Import all runs, seeds, task IDs, baseline, dispersion, and selected-checkpoint rule.

capabilities.claim_boundary: The task distribution and denominator are unknown on this host.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports a best held-out result of about 25%, with mass-matrix entries strongest.
capabilities.required_proof: Import evaluator, task strata, denominator, seeds, baseline, and checkpoint hash.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Artifact presence does not establish MNIST accuracy or general vision.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source node reported a missing weight; this PC has clay_mnist.pt, but no qualifying evaluator receipt was found.
capabilities.required_proof: Identify architecture, dataset split, preprocessing, evaluator, score, and checkpoint provenance.

capabilities.claim_boundary: This is deterministic tone transport, not English speech or learned audio understanding.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source-node review reports byte-preserving real-scale audio encode/decode.
capabilities.required_proof: Codec command, corpus size, corruption/noise conditions, exact round-trip counts, and artifact hashes.

capabilities.claim_boundary: This score applies to one scoped counting evaluator, not general mathematics or language ability.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The current stored sovereign checkpoint report records 0.296296 held-out accuracy.
capabilities.required_proof: Re-run evaluator, recover sample count and split definition, and add at least three seeds.

capabilities.claim_boundary: AAP predictions produced by external models or deterministic ensembles are not native Clay generation.
capabilities.evidence_summary: A trainer exists, but no promoted native generator checkpoint was identified.
capabilities.required_proof: Promoted generator, frozen task set, official-format validator, ROC-AUC receipt, cost, and safety failures.

capabilities.claim_boundary: A personality wrapper is not a native Clay language checkpoint.
capabilities.evidence_summary: A Modelfile exists on the source node, but its Clay Ollama alias was not installed.
capabilities.required_proof: Installed alias receipt plus explicit attribution to the underlying external model.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Clay cannot currently be represented as a native conversational language model.
capabilities.evidence_summary: No promoted native language checkpoint was identified in the source-node review.
capabilities.required_proof: Promoted checkpoint, held-out generation evaluator, task set, decoding configuration, and multi-seed result.

capabilities.claim_boundary: This is deterministic persisted state, not learned neural memory.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Files and the Context Ledger provide persistence.
capabilities.required_proof: Recovery drill, replica consistency receipt, retention policy, and outage behavior.

capabilities.claim_boundary: A deterministic compiler bijection is not native natural-language understanding.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Current-host session receipt reports 1,897,201/1,897,201 round-trips with zero ambiguity and deterministic execution checks.
capabilities.required_proof: Re-run the exact round-trip and malformed-input suites from a clean checkout.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Audio transport or tones do not establish speech recognition.
capabilities.evidence_summary: No speech-to-text model was found in the source-node review.
capabilities.required_proof: STT checkpoint, audio corpus provenance, WER evaluator, split, and noise strata.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Natural-language output belongs to the routed external model, not Clay's learned weights.
capabilities.evidence_summary: Terminal routing can call installed Qwen or Llama models.
capabilities.required_proof: Record the selected external model, version, prompt, tools, latency, and task receipt.

capabilities.claim_boundary: The deterministic terminal router works independently; a present learned weight has no qualified score yet.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source node reported its learned weight missing; this PC has clay_tool_router.pt. Deterministic routing and learned routing remain separate claims.
capabilities.required_proof: Import route labels and split, verify no shortcut leakage, compare zero-parameter and size-matched controls, and run multiple seeds.

capabilities.claim_boundary: Musical opcode audio must not be described as human speech.
capabilities.evidence_summary: No human-speech synthesizer was found in the source-node repository review.
capabilities.required_proof: TTS model, text normalization, vocoder, intelligibility evaluation, and audio samples.

capabilities.claim_boundary: A weight file and corpus do not establish coherent long-form generation.
capabilities.evidence_summary: The source node reported a missing source root; this PC has clay_writing.pt, but no promoted generation evaluator.
capabilities.required_proof: Recover tokenizer/architecture, generate on held-out prompts, blind-rate coherence/style, and compare baselines.
